rules.title: ⛔ Rules
rules.description: Let's create a safe and welcoming space guided by the following rules, non-compliance will result in an immediate ban or timeout from this server:

fields.name: 1. Be respectful
fields.value: Trash talking, toxicity, harassment, and any form of bullying will not be tolerated. Maintain discussions relevant to channel topics.

fields.name: 2. No spam
fields.value: Avoid any misuse of @ notifications (@everyone / @here) to gain attention. Spamming messages or repetitive text is strictly prohibited.

fields.name: 3. No self-promotion
fields.value: Do not use this server to excessively self-promote by shilling tweets, sending irrelevant external links, or advertising. This includes linking to other discord servers.

fields.name: 4. No to scam & phishing
fields.value: Any promotion of illegal activities, sending phishing links, or fake giveaways will result in an immediate permanent ban.

fields.name: 5. API & Account Security
fields.value: Never share your API secret keys, passwords, or broker credentials. Pixel team members will NEVER DM you first or ask for credentials.

fields.name: 6. Non-Custodial & Financial Disclaimer
fields.value: Pixel provides market research and REST API signal execution. We do not manage member funds or offer financial advice (NFA / DYOR).

fields.name: 7. Respect Discord TOS
fields.value: All members must abide by the official Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

getStarted.title: 🚀 Getting Started with Pixel Alpha
getStarted.description:
From a standing start, connecting takes about ten minutes, most of which is the exchange’s own security prompts.

• **Create a free Pixel Alpha account** — no card, no payment details, nothing to cancel.
• **Open your exchange API management** — create a key with Futures trading enabled and withdrawals disabled.
• **Allow-list our server IP** — ensure trades execute with zero interruption.
• **Paste key & secret** — connect your exchange on the dashboard.
• **Transfer USDT** — keep at least 1,000 USDT in your USD-M Futures wallet.

*That is the end of your involvement. The next signal trades your account automatically!*

fields.name: 01. Account & Capital Requirement
fields.value:
• Register your free account on [pixel-alpha.com](https://pixel-alpha.com/auth).
• You need a verified Binance account with USD-M Futures enabled.
• Minimum **1,000 USDT** deposited in your **USD-M Futures wallet** (funds in Spot wallet cannot be traded and will not be seen).

fields.name: 02. Create API Key on Binance
fields.value:
Go to Binance > [API Management](https://www.binance.com/en/my/settings/api-management) > **Create API**.
• Signature Type: **System generated (HMAC)** only. *(Ed25519 and RSA keys cannot be used)*.
• Label it: `Pixel Alpha`.

fields.name: 03. Set Permissions (Non-Custodial)
fields.value:
• ✅ Check **Enable Futures** (required to open and close positions).
• ❌ Leave **Enable Withdrawals** switched **OFF** (we never hold or move your funds).
• *You keep 100% custody at all times and can revoke the key instantly.*

fields.name: 04. Allow-list Server IP (Crucial Step)
fields.value:
Tick *Restrict access to trusted IPs only* and add our server IP:
`2.24.139.176`
*(⚠️ Missing this causes Binance to silently reject trade requests while your account looks connected).*

fields.name: 05. Connect & Activate on Dashboard
fields.value:
Paste your API Key & Secret into the [Pixel Alpha Dashboard](https://pixel-alpha.com/dashboard/exchanges/connect). Click **Connect** — your setup is complete!

💡 *Want to watch first? You can also connect a Binance testnet key and let the bot run on play money.*

faq.title: ❓ Pixel Alpha — Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our automated trading bot, non-custodial security, pricing, and performance:

fields.name: 01. What is Pixel Alpha?
fields.value: Pixel Alpha is an automated crypto futures trading bot that runs on your own exchange. Our systematic strategy sends signals, and orders execute in your account in seconds — whether you are at your screen or asleep.

fields.name: 02. Do you have access to my funds?
fields.value: **Never.** Your funds remain in your Binance account in your own name. The API key carries **trading permission only** and cannot withdraw, transfer, or convert funds. You can revoke the key anytime.

fields.name: 03. How much does it cost? (Pricing)
fields.value: **100% Free to use.** No upfront cost, no subscription, and no charge during flat or losing periods. We only charge a **20% performance fee on realized profit**, invoiced monthly above your **High-Water Mark**.

fields.name: 04. What are the account requirements?
fields.value:
• A verified **Binance** account with USD-M Futures.
• At least **1,000 USDT** deposited in your USD-M Futures wallet.
• Trade-only HMAC API key with server IP `2.24.139.176` allow-listed.

fields.name: 05. Which exchanges are supported?
fields.value:
• **Binance USD-M Futures** (Live today)
• **Bybit** (Coming soon)
• **MEXC** (Coming soon)
*(We do not support CFDs or equity brokers).*

fields.name: 06. How does risk management work?
fields.value:
• **Proportional Sizing:** Position size scales with your account balance.
• **Position Caps:** Maximum exposure limits prevent over-allocation.
• **Automatic Exits:** Strict rule-based closures, retried automatically if exchange lags.

fields.name: 07. Where can I get support?
fields.value: Open a ticket in <#1545070643744215212> or email us directly at **support@pixel-alpha.com**.
